The quietest drives a man
will ever take

1. Home from the hospital
with a newborn:

Ten miles an hour.
Every bump feels huge.

2. To a job interview that
could change everything:

Practicing answers
at every red light.

4. The first drive after
choosing a new life:

New habits. New goals.
Nobody knows yet.
